title: Projects
text:
NBA Player Classifier

Exploratory Project using Scikit-Learn to train a Machine Learning model to predict which Player Image was submitted using Python. Libraries used, Image Collection: selenium, Data Cleaning: Open-cv, Training: Scikit-learn

AutoXL

Automating Monthly Budget Dashboard Data Entry. Data collection and entry streamlined using SQL and Python. Used OpenXl for connection to Excel, Pandas and SQLite3 for database and data aggregation.

Flight Destination Delta (In-progress)

Used data collected from Delta API to predict which flights are more likely to be empty. Led to multiple travels on stand by.

title: About
text:
About Me
Some info about me outside of technical side!
Traveling

I enjoy traveling and using Film Photography to document my experiences. I have gone to Japan, Korea, Spain, London, France, and Italy!

Reading

In a fast-paced digital age, it is hard to slow down my mind at times. By reading I disconnect from my phone and let my mind relax. I aim to read at least 1 book per month. So far I’m 5 in.

title: Angel Zarate UW Senior
text:
UW Applied & Computational Mathematical Sciences: Data Science & Statistics
I am a Senior studying ACMS: Data Science at the University of Washington Seattle. I enjoy using programming as a tool to help me achieve my goals, express my creativity, and push the boundaries of cutting-edge technology like AI/ML.
Currently: Working at U.W. Dermatology Finance Department, where I get hands-on experience developing Dashboards, optimizing data pipelines, and communicating needs from Financial Analyst to iteratively make Financial reporting more streamlined.
Developing, planning, and working toward a common goal takes a lot of work. I am using my GitHub to showcase the skills I have learned and how they apply to the research I am assisting with as well as show my dedication to proper Software Development.
